prompt: Create a 24-icon style reference board. The attached SIX-ICON ATLAS PREVIEW is the authoritative VISUAL STYLE reference: reproduce its flat cool-gray background (#F0F0F5), charcoal gray thin uniform strokes (#353840), sparse simple geometry, low detail, generous whitespace, completely flat 2D rendering. NOT a rich icon illustration sheet. Do not reproduce its six subjects; use the 24 subjects below. Every icon must be as simplified as those six examples, at most a few essential interior lines. Uniform thin stroke around 1/24 of the icon width; no filled areas, shadows, texture, multicolor, gradients, bevel, 3D, glow. Landscape 1536x1024, 6 columns 4 rows. Subjects should occupy only about 45-50% of each cell width; ample open space like reference. No labels or borders. ROW1 flashcards with graduation cap; ear with sound waves; speaking mouth with waves; open book bookmark; paper pencil; three puzzle pieces. ROW2 brain refresh badge; stopwatch lightning; calendar check; branching nodes; folded route map; hill flag. ROW3 circled check; heart return arrow; lightbulb star; locked book; two shooting stars; gift question mark. ROW4 three people star; shield upward chevron; shield snowflake; certificate seal; globe speech bubble; circled accessibility person. Keep all symbols recognizable but use minimum structural detail. Opaque background. Input reference controls style, background and negative space.
